```yaml
name: Replay Benchmark

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest pre-commit

      - name: Check environment
        run: |
          python check_env.py --auto-install

      - name: Run replay benchmark
        run: |
          mkdir -p benchmarks
          python scripts/run_replay_bench.py

      - name: Upload benchmark results
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/upload-benchmark-results@main
        with:
          benchmark-results-dir: benchmarks
          benchmark-name: replay-benchmark
          schema-version: '1.0'
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update benchmark history
        run: |
          # Create or update the benchmark history CSV
          if [ ! -f docs/bench_history.csv ]; then
            echo "timestamp,metric,value" > docs/bench_history.csv
          fi
          
          # Get current timestamp and benchmark value
          TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
          BENCHMARK_VALUE=$(python -c "import json; data = json.load(open('benchmarks/results.json')); print(data.get('score', 'N/A'))")
          
          # Append to CSV
          echo "$TIMESTAMP,replay_score,$BENCHMARK_VALUE" >> docs/bench_history.csv

      - name: Commit updated benchmark history
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        with:
          commit_message: "Update benchmark history"
          file_pattern: docs/bench_history.csv

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest -q

      - name: Post pytest results
        uses: pmeier/pytest-results-action@v0.7.2
        with:
          path: .
          summary: true
          display-options: "failed,skipped"
          title: "Test Results"

      - name: Track workflow performance
        uses: PostHog/posthog-github-action@eea1405eeb2d1d2259f0ee0b44d7b152869e6840
        with:
          posthog-token: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_TOKEN }}
          event: "replay_benchmark_workflow"
          properties: '{"workflow": "replay_benchmark", "status": "${{ job.status }}"}'
          capture-run-duration: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          runner: ${{ runner.name }}
          status-job: ${{ job.status }}
```
